hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling Delafield WI, Planned in Our Design Center
hero.subheadline: Callen has remodeled Southeastern Wisconsin homes since 1986. Sit down with a kitchen and bath Sales • Design Consultant at our new Delafield Design Center, see 3D views of your plan, and let the same team build it.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Delafield WI area: Oconomowoc open kitchen with wood island, white cabinets and a great room with large picture windows

intro.h2: Lake Country now has a Callen Design Center down the road
paragraphs: Callen brings kitchen remodeling Delafield WI homeowners can see and touch before they commit. Our new Design Center on Hillside Drive has displays featuring Kohler, Starmark Cabinetry, Infinity by Marvin, ProVia and HomeStory doors. The original Design Center and office in Muskego is still open, too.

Two brothers started Callen in 1986. Michael and Christiane Wood took over in 2023 with a plan to keep the company's standards while adopting newer building science and installation methods. Kitchens and baths are planned as complete rooms, with layout, storage, lighting, cabinetry and surfaces chosen together, and every project carries a lifetime workmanship warranty.

services.h2: Kitchens, baths and the rest of the house

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen designs, not partial updates. Your Sales • Design Consultant draws detailed plans and 3D views, then helps you choose cabinets from lines such as Starmark and Ultracraft, Kohler faucets and the surfaces that suit how you cook and entertain.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel with white and stained wood cabinets, quartz peninsula, open wood shelves and glass pendants

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Bathrooms planned as one system, covering layout, moisture control, durable materials and comfort. Callen uses high-performance surfaces like Onyx for clean lines that last, and offers accessible features, spa-style showers and freestanding tubs. Your consultant shows 3D views of the room before any work starts.

image.alt: Primary bathroom remodel with a freestanding tub, sage green tile shower and black grid fluted glass partition

items.name: Interior Spaces
items.blurb: Main floors, laundry rooms, mudrooms and attic conversions, designed to match the rest of the house. The focus is on flow, organization and storage, with finishes carried from room to room so new spaces blend with the old ones.

image.alt: Laundry and mudroom remodel with gray and walnut cabinets, quartz folding counter, built-in bench and coat hooks

items.name: Replacement Windows
items.blurb: Infinity by Marvin windows made from Ultrex fiberglass, rated 8 times stronger than vinyl and backed by a limited lifetime warranty. Callen is an Infinity by Marvin Platinum Dealer and can cut new openings when a design calls for it.

image.alt: White farmhouse with black Infinity by Marvin replacement windows, covered porch and stone walkway

items.name: Entry, Storm and Patio Doors
items.blurb: ProVia entry and storm doors, HomeStory interior doors and patio doors, all installation-only. HomeStory doors are laser-measured for a precise fit, and storm doors help protect your entry from Wisconsin wind and cold while adding ventilation and curb appeal.

image.alt: Charcoal ProVia entry door with glass sidelites and white trim on a gray-sided home with brick steps

why_choose_us.h2: Why Lake Country homeowners choose Callen

items.title: Nearly four decades in Wisconsin
items.text: Callen has served Southeastern Wisconsin since 1986. Production manager Steve Turzinski started as a carpenter helper 25 years ago, and designer Paulette Sodemann has been with Callen for nearly 20 years.

items.title: Certified kitchen and bath designers
items.text: The kitchen and bath team includes Jennifer Earhart, CKBR, Paulette Sodemann, CKBR, CRD, and Danni Maddison, CRD, UDCP, plus Ryan Rieck as project manager and estimator.

items.title: Two design centers to visit
items.text: See products in person at the Muskego Design Center and office or the new Delafield Design Center. Both are open weekdays 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Saturdays 9 a.m. to 2 p.m.

items.title: Backed for the long run
items.text: Every project comes with a lifetime workmanship warranty. Google reviewers describe the work as "meticulous from sales to ordering to install" and praise the honesty of the first estimate visit.

about.text: Two brothers founded Callen in 1986, and for almost four decades it has remodeled homes across Southeastern Wisconsin. Since 2023 the company has been owned by Michael Wood, its president and director of sales and business development, and Christiane Wood, vice president. Their stated aim is to respect Callen's legacy while embracing progress in building science and installation methods. In 2026 they opened a second Design Center in Delafield to bring that experience closer to Lake Country homeowners, where clients work directly with Sales • Design Consultants, project managers and the carpentry team.
about.owner_role: President, Director of Sales and Business Development

process.h2: Design, Build, Live: how a Callen remodel works

steps.title: Meet at the Design Center
steps.text: Your project starts with a collaborative conversation with a Sales • Design Consultant at the Muskego or Delafield Design Center.

steps.title: Plans and 3D views
steps.text: After a retainer agreement, your consultant creates detailed plans, drawings and 3D views and guides finish, color, layout and fixture choices.

steps.title: Accurate estimate
steps.text: Because the same team designs and builds, it knows how each design choice affects cost and prices your project from the finished design.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Once the design is final and the budget is agreed, the same design-build team handles construction with professional project management.

steps.title: Live with it
steps.text: Your finished kitchen or bath is backed by a lifetime workmanship warranty, and the service team stays available after the job is done.

service_area.h2: Serving Lake Country and Southeastern Wisconsin
service_area.text: With Design Centers in Delafield and Muskego, Callen serves homeowners across Southeastern Wisconsin. Lake Country towns like Delafield, Oconomowoc, Hartland, Pewaukee and Dousman are minutes from the Hillside Drive Design Center. The Muskego office covers Waukesha, Brookfield, New Berlin and Milwaukee County, and the team also works north to Mequon and Cedarburg and south to Racine and Burlington. If your town is not listed, ask; the list is 'including but not limited to'.

faq.h2: Questions about kitchen remodeling Delafield WI homeowners ask

items.q: Where can I see materials before I decide?
items.a: Visit either Design Center. The new Delafield location is at 2736 Hillside Drive, and the original Design Center and office is at S63W13131 Janesville Road in Muskego. Both are open Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., and Saturday, 9 a.m. to 2 p.m., with displays from Kohler, Starmark Cabinetry and Infinity by Marvin.

items.q: How does pricing work with design-build?
items.a: Design starts after a retainer agreement. Your consultant then produces plans, drawings and 3D views and helps you select finishes. Because the same team designs and builds, it can tie each choice to its cost and give an accurate estimate. Construction begins once the design is final and the budget is agreed.

Yes. Through Regions Bank, on approved credit, Callen offers a 12-month same-as-cash loan, with interest waived if repaid within 365 days, and a traditional installment loan with fixed APRs starting at 8.99%. For Wisconsin residents the APR will not exceed 17.99%. Your Sales • Design Consultant can help you choose.

items.q: What warranty comes with a Callen remodel?
items.a: Callen provides a lifetime workmanship warranty on its remodeling work. Infinity by Marvin windows and patio doors also carry a limited lifetime warranty from the manufacturer. Callen's service team, including a service manager and service technician, handles follow-up after the project is complete.

items.q: Which cabinet and fixture brands do you use?
items.a: Kitchens often feature Starmark Cabinets or Ultracraft Cabinets with Kohler faucets, and bathrooms use high-performance surfaces like Onyx. For windows and doors, Callen installs Infinity by Marvin, ProVia entry and storm doors and HomeStory interior doors. Consultants can show past projects to help you choose.

final_cta.h2: Plan your kitchen at the Delafield Design Center
final_cta.text: Call (414) 529-5509 or request a consultation, then stop by 2736 Hillside Drive to see cabinets, counters and fixtures in person.
